packages.name: @adhd/sox-source-provider
packages.purpose: Unified SCM/filesystem abstraction — file tree enumeration and raw content retrieval from GitHub, Bitbucket, and the local filesystem through a single SourceProvider interface, without cloning.
capabilities: No-clone file tree enumeration from GitHub, Bitbucket, local filesystem
SourceRef URL parsing and normalization (github.com/owner/repo[@ref], bitbucket.org/ws/repo[@ref], local:/abs/path)
Typed SourceProviderError taxonomy (auth, rate-limit, truncation, not-found, transient)
invariants: No search()/discovery — explicit refs only
SourceRef.parse() THROWS InvalidSourceRefError on unparseable input
Manifest.truncated === true means entry list is incomplete
Every thrown error is a typed subclass of SourceProviderError
No on-disk or in-memory caching — SourceProvider is the I/O layer only

packages.name: @adhd/sox-manifest
packages.purpose: Extension manifest schema and validate() — single source of truth for manifest validation and extension contracts.
capabilities: Extended runtime types: node, shell, python, declarative, stdio-any
invariants: Single source of truth for all extension manifest structures
Pure lib — no devkit, no framework imports
CJS output (module=CommonJS) for Node require() compatibility

packages.name: @adhd/sox-task-queue
packages.purpose: Durable SQLite-backed task queue — atomic priority-aware FIFO claim/lease, retry with exponential backoff, heartbeat lease management, worker pool, and cron scheduler.
capabilities: SQLite-backed durable task queue with WAL mode
Atomic priority-aware FIFO claiming via UPDATE ... RETURNING
Heartbeat-based lease management with expiry reaping
Idempotent enqueue via request_ledger dedup table
Croner-backed cron scheduler with persisted entries
invariants: Durability: enqueue() committed to SQLite before Promise resolves
At-least-once execution: every queued task executes at least once
Dequeue eligibility uniform for 'queued' and 'scheduled' (scheduled_at IS NULL OR scheduled_at <= now)
Fail applies exponential backoff using PRE-increment retryCount
Lease-expiry re-queue consumes one retry slot
close()/WorkerPool.stop() never force-kill running handlers
All mutating operations THROW TaskQueueNotOpenError when closed

packages.name: @adhd/sox-vector-store
packages.purpose: Multi-space vector persistence with two real, swappable VectorBackend implementations: sqlite-vec (brute-force kNN) and LanceDB (HNSW/IVF-PQ ANN indexes).
capabilities: Multi-space vec0 persistence (SqliteVectorBackend — one virtual table per VectorSpace)
Multi-space on-disk LanceDB persistence with real HNSW (hnswSq) and IVF-PQ ANN indexes
Worker_threads + synckit sync RPC bridge to make async LanceDB satisfy synchronous interface
kNN/cosine search (brute-force sqlite-vec or ANN-accelerated LanceDB)
Space invariant enforcement (SpaceInvariantError on dim mismatch)
invariants: ensureSpace(space) MUST be called before first upsert on any new (modelId, dim) pair
upsert() THROWS SpaceInvariantError when vec.length !== space.dim
A model switch is a re-embed migration, never a hot-swap into the same vec0 table
reembed() does NOT delete source vectors
delete(id, modelId) is scoped to a single space

packages.name: @adhd/sox-ingest
packages.purpose: Write-path single-item transforms — content-hash (SHA-256), extractive summary, deterministic tag extraction, and chunking with registry-based extensibility.
capabilities: Content-hash (SHA-256 of normalized content — used for graph-store dedup)
Extractive summary (lead-N sentences — first summaryMaxSentences, no scoring, zero LLM)
Deterministic tag extraction (noun phrases, high-frequency terms, tagMaxCount)
Chunking with maxChars / overlapChars sliding window
Per-chunk contentHash for dedup at chunk level
AST chunker with tree-sitter support (TypeScript, Python, Java, C#)
Mixed-format chunking (heading + AST combo with section nesting)
invariants: Zero-LLM, zero-I/O, synchronous — ingest() is a pure function
Deterministic + byte-reproducible — same input always produces same hash, summary, tags
dist/core.js is CJS-safe (no top-level await) for CommonJS consumers
dist/index.js is ESM-only (contains AstChunker with await Parser.init())

packages.name: @adhd/sox-hybrid-search
packages.purpose: Generic hybrid retrieval ranker — fuses vector similarity + text relevance signals via normalized RRF/max-score fusion. Mechanism-agnostic: textScore / vecScore.
capabilities: SearchBackend interface (mechanism-agnostic: textScore / vecScore, not BM25 / cosine)
Pure fuse() + normalize() exports (no storage dep)
invariants: SearchBackend.search() degrades to text-only when query.vec absent
SearchBackend.search() degrades to vec-only when query.text absent
Scores normalized BEFORE combining (never raw scale-blind additive merge)
textScore / vecScore are mechanism-agnostic names
fuse() weights must be multiplicative (field boosting), never additive

packages.name: @adhd/sox-embedding-provider
packages.purpose: Pluggable text→vector embedding provider — generic EmbeddingProvider interface, config-driven model resolution, async batch-first API.
capabilities: Fastembed local ONNX inference with HNSW support
Remote embedding provider with configurable endpoint
invariants: createEmbeddingProvider() THROWS ResolutionError synchronously if config invalid or model cannot load
Every provider advertises { modelId, dimensions, isRemote, isDeterministic, providerUri? } via metadata
embedBatch() returns AsyncIterable<Float32Array> — callers receive first result before last batch finishes
warmUp() is a no-op when isDeterministic === false
TransientEmbeddingError → caller may retry; PermanentEmbeddingError → caller must not retry

packages.name: @adhd/sox-blob-store
packages.purpose: Content-addressable blob storage: SHA-256 CAS write, SQLite reference tracking, stream-based API, mark-and-sweep GC with grace periods, FD guard.
capabilities: Mark-and-sweep GC with configurable grace period
In-process FD guard (prevents GC of open blobs)
Integrity verification on read (default) and write (optional)
invariants: put() is always idempotent — content-hash dedup is universal
rename() is atomic when tempDir and basePath are on the same filesystem
GC never deletes a blob that has an open FD in the in-process guard
get() returns null for not-found; throws IntegrityMismatch for corruption
Orphan temp files cleaned up on next open() (crash recovery)

packages.name: @adhd/sox-claim-verification
packages.purpose: NLI-based (Natural Language Inference) claim grounding engine. Cross-encoder NLI via worker thread, embedding pre-filter, configurable truncation, LRU result cache.
capabilities: NLI claim grounding via cross-encoder ONNX inference
invariants: ONNX inference runs exclusively in worker threads
Pre-filter uses its OWN embedding provider instance
warmUp() must complete before verify* calls
Language mismatch downgrades to 'neutral' with warning flag
Claim normalization strips citation markers before NLI

packages.name: @adhd/sox-graph-store
packages.purpose: Bi-temporal graph store — nodes + edges over SQLite with t_valid/t_invalid correctness, tExpires TTL, content-hash dedup, FTS5 sync, namespace isolation, and supersession chains.
capabilities: Schema migration via drizzle-orm (generated offline, applied idempotently at runtime)
Bi-temporal nodes (t_valid / t_invalid) + tExpires TTL + isStale derived field
FTS5 sync triggers (searchNodes scored by mechanism-agnostic score field)
Edge upsert idempotency (writeEdge — safe for re-projection)
DEPENDS_ON edge rel for typed dependency graphs
invariants: Records are NEVER deleted — invalidate() sets t_invalid (audit-preserving)
supersede() mints a new node linked by SUPERSEDES
touch() updates mutable metadata without minting a new node
writeEdge() is upsert-idempotent on (src, dst, rel)
writeGraph() / writeNodeBatch() are atomic
searchNodes() returns [] when capabilities.fullTextSearch === false
NodeFilter.validAt honored only when capabilities.bitemporal === true

packages.name: @adhd/sox-analysis
packages.purpose: Batch derivation over a corpus — clustering (density-clustering), near-dup detection, importance + link scoring, and pure graph algorithms (topoSort, criticalPath, detectCycles, packBatches).
capabilities: Near-dup detection (NearDupPair with near_dup / candidate / distinct status)
Auto-linking (similarity-threshold edge creation, RELATES_TO by default)
Pure topoSort + wave assignment (Kahn BFS, cycle detection + recovery)
detectCycles (all cycles, not just first — for user-facing error messages)
invariants: Operates over a corpus (batch), never per-query
Clustering uses existing JS lib (density-clustering) — NOT hand-rolled DBSCAN
All DB-integrated functions take (VectorBackend, GraphBackend) directly
Similarity-based outputs MUST record the modelId they were computed under
computeImportance / buildAutoLinks are incremental by default
topoSort / criticalPath / detectCycles accept caller-supplied adjacency function
packBatches shared resource cost is submodular (union cost)
